name: Le Quizz du Berger
description: Free political quiz for the 2027 French presidential election. Compares a user's answers with 40 candidates across 21 themes and 174 questions.
when_to_use: A user asks which French 2027 presidential candidate matches their political views
A user asks about a specific candidate's position on a topic (immigration, pensions, climate, security, energy, Europe…)
A user wants to compare two French candidates or parties on a specific theme
A user asks about 2027 French presidential election polls
A user wants context or analysis of a current French political topic
A user asks who has declared, withdrawn, or is expected to run in the 2027 French presidential election
when_not_to_use: A candidate's personal life or legal affairs outside their programme
Electoral predictions — the quiz measures proximity of ideas, not voting intentions
